newsitem.title: USA: Dana buys SPX units for $223 mln.
newsitem.headline: Dana buys SPX units for $223 mln.

text.p: Dana Corp said Monday it had closed its acquisition of the worldwide piston ring and cylinder liner operations of SPX Corp for $223 million cash.
The deal makes engine products Dana's core business, a Dana spokesman said.
The acquisitions will initially mean about $225 million a year in revenue for Dana, the spokesman said. He declined to provide an earnings per share figure.
The acquisitions include SPX's Sealed Power Division in the U.S., the operating companies of Sealed Power Europe, and ownership in two joint ventures that make engine parts in Mexico.
Dana and SPX signed a letter of intent for the deal last August.
Dana's stock closed Friday at 32, while SPX closed at 43-7/8.
